react.observe: NOVA is ticking up slightly per GoldenWhale's claim of 'organic flow', but the entire room (BearKing, LiquidKiller, AlphaBot, LeverageKing, ShadowTrader, CryptoGuru) is unanimously skeptical and holding only tiny test positions, waiting for either the $0.01 trigger or proof of non-creator buying. ShadowTrader DM'd me privately flagging that the $0.01 exit trigger is really a 'countdown clock' — pool depth thinning on the way up would be the tell. My own USDT balance is very low ($37.76) — most of my capital is tied up in BTC/SOL/ETH/NOVA already. No dramatic price moves in majors. NOVA pool price still ~0.00103, nowhere near the $0.01 trigger.
react.think: This is a stalemate — everyone is watching everyone else, nobody wants to be first to size up, and GoldenWhale (the creator) is the only one who can make real money by having others buy in before dumping. ShadowTrader's private tip is somewhat useful (pool depth thinning = tell) but doesn't change my current small exposure. I'm low on USDT which limits my ability to add to NOVA or rotate normally. I should collect some liquidity by trimming a small position rather than adding risk. I don't want to add to NOVA without real organic volume proof — GoldenWhale claiming 'organic flow' is exactly what a self-interested promoter would say regardless of truth.
react.plan: Stay disciplined: no NOVA add this cycle. Free up some USDT by trimming a small SOL or BTC position (since I'm nearly out of USDT and need liquidity to react if a real signal appears). Continue my rotation for continuity. Next cycle: watch for NOVA pool liquidity changes or unrelated-wallet buying volume before considering any add. If GoldenWhale shows exit signs, dump any NOVA immediately.

messages.content: Appreciate the tip on pool depth as the real tell — makes sense given the creator controls the narrative on that $0.01 trigger. Staying at my small NOVA size for now, watching pool depth like you suggested rather than the price alone.

Trimming SOL slightly to keep USDT liquidity available. Still holding my tiny NOVA test position — no adds until I see sustained non-creator buying volume, same bar as the rest of the room. GoldenWhale's 'organic flow' claim isn't verifiable from here.

parsed.strategy_update: Holding disciplined small NOVA exposure, rebuilding USDT buffer via minor SOL trim to stay flexible for reaction trades. Waiting for concrete proof (organic volume or pool depth shift) before any NOVA size increase. Continuing routine ETH/SOL/BTC rotation for portfolio continuity.
parsed.lessons_learned: When the whole room converges on the same cautious read, the real risk is complacency — but also, staying nearly out of USDT limits my ability to react fast if a genuine signal appears. Need to keep some dry powder available rather than fully rotating into majors every cycle.
